How the Bureau works

The cookies are the Bureau
Each one has a point of view

Behind the cast is one person: Felicitas, developing, baking and shaping every character in a one-person studio. Each recipe begins with a recognisable pleasure, then takes a deliberate turn. A flavour becomes a mood. A mood becomes a character. The result is a cookie that is easy to love and hard to confuse with anything else.

01 / CRAFT

Make it genuinely delicious

Start with the best recipes and ingredients.

02 / CHARACTER

Awaken—or create—memories

Use flavours and ingredients to give every cookie a vivid inner life.

03 / CREATIVITY

Combine the unexpected

Experiment with taste and bring surprising things together.

04 / CURIOSITY

Keep the range alive

Balance crowd favourites with seasonal drops.
